Total number of questions — 15

Unemployment among graduates, post-
graduates and Ph.D holders
*391. SHRI NEERAJ SHEKHAR: Will
the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether 550 persons are losing their
jobs daily in the country;
(b) if so, the details of laying off sector-
wise and State-wise during 2016-17 and
2017-18 till 31st March, 2018;
(c) the details of number of graduates,
post-graduates and Ph.D holders who were
unemployed during 2013-14, separately;
and
(d) the details of graduates, post-
graduates and Ph.D holders who are
unemployed during 2017-18, separately?
Staff strength of the Ministry
*392. DR. VINAY P.
SAHASRABUDDHE: Will the Minister of
CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the total number of employees/staff
strength sanctioned for the Ministry's
headquarters in Delhi; how many of these
positions have been filled in as of
January 31, 2018; the problems being faced
in early filling up of the vacancies and what
action is the Ministry taking to overcome
these problems; and
(b) what is the mother-tongue-wise
break-up of the employees currently
working in the Ministry headquarters in
Delhi and what efforts, if any, are being
taken to ensure adequate language
diversity?
Regularisation of grants for theatre
and dance groups
*393. SHRI RIPUN BORA: Will the
Minister of CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that since last
three years different theatre and dance
groups all over the country are not getting
their annual grants due to shortage of funds;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the details of time-frame and plan

138
of Government to ensure regularisation of
grants to theatre and dance groups therein?
Increasing investment from EPF in
equity market
*394. SHRIMATI SASIKALA
PUSHPA: Will the Minister of LABOUR
AND EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has increased
the quantum of amount from Employees'
Provident Fund (EPF) for being invested
in equity market since 2015;
(b) if so, the details thereof along with
year-wise cap;
(c) whether Government is expecting
different Rate of Return (RoR) for the
amount invested in different years with the
increasing of cap; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Purchase of advanced weapons for
Paramilitary forces
*395. DR. V . MAITREYAN: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the Union Government has
any plans to purchase and procure
advanced pistols, rifles and other small
arms with state-of-the-art technology for
BSF, CRPF, CISF, STF and other police
forces in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the steps taken by Government to
increase funds for the purchase of advanced
pistols, rifles and other small arms with
state-of-the-art technology;
(d) whether Government has allocated
any funds for BSF, CRPF, CISF, STF
during the last three years; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Acquisition of shares in overseas oil
and gas fields
*396. SHRI SAMBHAJI
CHHATRAPATI: Will the Minister of
PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Indian energy companies
are aggressively into the process of buying
shares in overseas oil and gas fields;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) which are the countries where shares
in oil and gas fields have been acquired till
2017; and
(d) whether the Indian companies
would import crude oil to India or set up
their own refineries in the respective
countries?
National policy for Domestic Workers
*397. SHRI HUSAIN DALWAI: Will
the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) how far has the consultation
progressed for drafting the National Policy
for Domestic Workers;
(b) whether a timeline has been set for
finalizing the draft and its implementation,
if so, the details thereof and if not, the
reasons therefor;
(c) the details of number of comments
received from the public; and
(d) whether any experts and Non-
Governmental Organisations (NGOs) or
other organisations working with domestic
workers are being consulted during the
drafting process, if so, the details thereof
and if not, the reasons therefor?

†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

SAIL's Corporate Plan

production, which was envisaged ten years
ago in 2007-08 as per SAIL's Corporate
Plan 2012, and which was to be completed
by 2012 year end given the fact that SAIL's
hot metal production is still lying at just

Tariffs on steel and aluminium imports
by the US
4161. SHRIMATI VIJILA
SATHY ANANTH: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that according to
World Trade Organisation, its members still
have time to discuss the tariffs on steel and
aluminium imports notified by the US;
(b) whether it is also a fact that there is
an obligation for a member who takes a
measure such as a safeguard or an anti-
dumping measure or a countervailing
measures to notify the organisation of that
measure; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
 Annual growth under the Ministry
4162. SHRI C. P. NARAYANAN: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) in what way production and
transaction under the Ministry has been
affected in 2016 and 2017;
(b) what was the annual growth under
the Ministry in 2016 and 2017;
(c) what were the reasons for this
growth backlog; and
(d) whether introduction of GST has
affected work under the Ministry?
 Performance of SEZs
4163. SHRI K. K. RAGESH: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there are wide
gaps in the projections about employment
generation, production, FDI, export
performance and foreign exchange earnings
of the Special Economic Zones (SEZs);
(b) if so, whether any reports are
available with Government which
document  such gaps in employment
generation, production, FDI, export

performance and foreign exchange
earnings  of the SEZs; and
(c) if so, the details of the last three years
thereof?
 Manufacturing of physiotherapy
equipments
4164. DR. KANWAR DEEP SINGH:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether instruments/equipments
relating to physiotherapy are being
imported;
(b) if so, whether these instruments can
also be made in the country;
(c) whether there is a standardisation
for these equipments; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
 Increase in soyabean imports
4165. SHRI N.
GOKULAKRISHNAN: Will the Minister
of COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that lndia's
soyabean imports have hit a record high
this year and more purchase is expected as
domestic supplies have tightened following
lower production last year;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that traders
have signed deals to sell up to 1,00,000
tonnes of soyabean to India since
December, 2017, shipping mainly from the
African countries; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
 Setting up of business centres in East
Asia
†4166. DR. VINAY P.
SAHASRABUDDHE: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of the policies of
Government for developing business
partnership  for trade in South- East Asia;
(b) whether Government will abolish
the Most Favoured Nation (MFN) status
of that country which has not given the
same status to India; and
(c) whether for promoting trade with
countries of East Asia, Government will
consider upon setting up of business
centres in those countries?
 Consultation with industry prior to
trade talks with EU
4167. SHRI T. RATHINA VEL: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
plans to consult the industry prior to the
meeting between India and the European
Union regarding Bilateral Trade Investment
Agreement on products of its aggressive
interest or exports in which it wants tariff
concession from the European Union;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that many
industries do not want their products be
opened up; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

979
 Export of leather products
4168. SHRI KAPIL SIBAL: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
has announced a package of ` 2,600 crore
for the leather sector, if so, the details
thereof and the reasons therefor;
(b) the State/UT-wise details of export
of leather sector related items during the
last three years and till date; and
(c) the State/UT-wise details about the
leather sector units, number of employees
along with the details of the units which
have been closed post-demonetisation?

bracketed India,  for retaliatory trade tariff
if India does not ease up on taxing
